components.css: :host{--gold:#CFA670;--gold-soft:#E4CBA3;--night:#120806;--night-2:#1A0D09;--espresso:#270A03;--porcelain:#F4F2EF;--stone:#B4ACA5;--bronze:#77572B;--line:rgba(207,166,112,.22);--line-strong:rgba(207,166,112,.5);--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-ground{background:var(--night);padding:24px} .ds-btn-ghost{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:52px;padding:4px 26px 0;color:var(--porcelain);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-strong);font-family:'Josefin Sans',sans-serif;font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1;border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;text-decoration:none;transition:color 420ms var(--ease-out),box-shadow 420ms var(--ease-out)} .ds-btn-ghost::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--porcelain);transform:translateY(101%);transition:transform 420ms var(--ease-out);z-index:-1} .ds-btn-ghost:hover{color:var(--night);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--porcelain)} .ds-btn-ghost:hover::before{transform:none} .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px}

components.css: :host{--gold:#CFA670;--gold-soft:#E4CBA3;--night:#120806;--night-2:#1A0D09;--espresso:#270A03;--porcelain:#F4F2EF;--stone:#B4ACA5;--bronze:#77572B;--line:rgba(207,166,112,.22);--line-strong:rgba(207,166,112,.5);--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-wrap{background:var(--espresso);padding:40px 24px} .ds-ticket{max-width:420px;margin:0 auto;padding:64px 32px 48px;background:var(--porcelain);color:var(--espresso);border-radius:999px 999px 4px 4px;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.55),0 8px 18px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.35);font-family:'Josefin Sans',sans-serif} .ds-lbl{font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;color:var(--bronze)} .ds-name{font-family:'Rosalia SK','Josefin Sans',Georgia,serif;font-size:2.6rem;line-height:1;margin-top:16px} .ds-when{margin-top:24px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid #D9D2C9;display:grid;gap:4px;color:#564640;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums} .ds-when strong{font-weight:400;color:var(--espresso);font-size:1.125rem}

narrative.overview:
The Evening, Course by Course: the site is one evening at Antoni. Night grounds shift with the hour, from dusk forest to espresso to deepest night, and the home page is ordered as a sequence of timed chapters (18:30 Príchod through 21:00 Dezert a káva, ending at the guest's own reservation time). Professional seasonal plate photography carries the story at full bleed or inside the arch taken from the logo; Rosalia SK sets the hairline display voice in porcelain white, Josefin Sans carries everything practical. Lunch is daylight: the daily menu page flips to a porcelain ground.

Density is calm and editorial: generous section padding, one idea per chapter, lists set as ruled menu lines rather than boxed tiles. Luxury is expressed as stillness, detail and exact information (tabular prices, hours, allergens), never through gold ornament. Gold appears as thin lines, times, prices and the one primary action.

The motion grammar is part of the world: a monogram that draws itself, a hero photo that opens through the arch like a door, curtain reveals on photographs, a rolling odometer clock that tracks the chapter, and a body background that cross-fades to each chapter's tone. Everything collapses to static under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, warm night grounds by default; a single light "noon" theme for the daily menu.
Gold (#CFA670) is the only accent; on light grounds its text form is bronze.
The arch (fully rounded top, square bottom) is the signature frame for photos, the success ticket, notices and day tabs.
Hairline gold rules divide content; no card grids, no boxed tiles.
Rosalia SK display at weight 400 only; Josefin Sans for text and all UI.
Times of the evening in gold Rosalia are the home page's chapter markers and the reservation finale.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only accent hue. Forest and espresso are grounds, not accents; no second highlight color is introduced for emphasis.

rules.name: The Hour Ground Rule
rules.body: Section grounds are chosen by time of evening: forest-deep for dusk, espresso for feature chapters and reservation, night for the rest. Index chapters declare their tone and the body cross-fades to it (1.2s). Noon (porcelain) is reserved for lunch content.

rules.name: The Bronze-on-Light Rule
rules.body: On porcelain, any gold text becomes bronze; gold remains only as a fill or dot.

rules.name: The Single Weight Display Rule
rules.body: Rosalia SK is set at weight 400 with zero tracking and balanced wrapping; never bold, never letterspaced, never in uppercase.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Prices, hours, gramáž, dates and indices use `tabular-nums lining-nums`; prices are gold (bronze on noon) and never wrap.

rules.name: The Optical Baseline Rule
rules.body: Josefin Sans sits high in its box; pills and buttons compensate with extra top padding (for example `4px 26px 0`) rather than symmetric padding.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the element floats over the page (sheet, peek, ticket). Anything in flow is flat and separated by hairlines.

dos: **Do** keep gold (#CFA670) as the single accent, and switch gold text to bronze (#77572B) on porcelain.
**Do** frame hero and feature photographs in the arch (`999px 999px 0 0`), or let them run full bleed with a night scrim.
**Do** set lists as ruled menu lines with gold tabular prices on the right.
**Do** set Rosalia SK at weight 400 only, and use Josefin Sans for every label, button, field and paragraph.
**Do** give pills and buttons top-heavy padding (`4px … 0`) to center Josefin optically.
**Do** pick section grounds by the hour (forest-deep, espresso, night), and keep porcelain for lunch.
**Do** honor `prefers-reduced-motion` by rendering every reveal in its final state.
donts: **Don't** lay content out as grids of boxed cards; the reservation ticket is the only card.
**Don't** add a second accent color, gradients in gold, or gold ornament; luxury here is calm and exact.
**Don't** set Rosalia in bold, in uppercase, or with tracking, and don't use it for UI labels or numbers that need to align (it has no tabular figures).
**Don't** add drop shadows to in-flow elements; shadows are only for sheets, the peek and the ticket.
**Don't** use gold chapter times outside the evening sequence and the reservation clock; on other pages headings stand alone.
**Don't** round form fields like pills; fields stay at 2px.
